d:
Chala Jata Hoon Kisi Ki Dhun Mein is one of Bollywood's most carefree, timeless melodies from Mere Jeevan Saathi (1972), sung by Kishore Kumar at his liveliest, picturized on the charismatic Rajesh Khanna and Tanuja. Composed by R.D. Burman with poetic lyrics by Majrooh Sultanpuri, this evergreen classic was made at the very peak of Rajesh Khanna's superstardom, and remains one of the most loved Kishore-Pancham collaborations in Bollywood history.
Chala Jata Hoon kisi Ki Dhun Mein - Mere Jeevan Saathi (1972) | RD Burman | Rajesh Khanna, Tanuja
Song : Chala Jata Hoon kisi Ki Dhun Mein
